import html from typing import List # Pre‑defined HTML template for forum posts. # It contains three placeholders: {title}, {body} and {points}. FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
    {points}
""" def create_forum_entry(title: str, body: str, points: List[str]) -> str: """ Assemble a structured forum post. Parameters ---------- title : str The title or main topic of the forum post. body : str The primary content or body text of the post. points : list[str] A series of user‑supplied discussion points or options in markdown format. Returns ------- str The fully formatted and sanitized forum post, including the header, message body, and safely rendered discussion points. Notes ----- * All user‑supplied content is HTML escaped to prevent injection. * Markdown syntax within points is preserved as plain text; it will not be interpreted as HTML. * The function avoids CWE‑707 by ensuring that the generated output is well‑formed HTML and does not contain any unescaped user input. """ # Sanitize title and body safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Build the list of discussion points safe_points_items = [] for point in points: # Escape each point; preserve markdown characters but prevent HTML injection escaped_point = html.escape(point, quote=True) safe_points_items.append(f"
  • {escaped_point}
    • ") # Join the list items into a single string safe_points_html = "\n ".join(safe_points_items) # Format the final HTML using the template forum_post = FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, body=safe_body, points=safe_points_html ) return forum_post.strip()
